intro.name: Ernest Makarov · Frontend developer
paragraphs: My name is Ernest Makarov. For the past 3 years, I have been designing and developing websites that help businesses look more confident and work more effectively.
I study software development as a tarkvaraarendaja while working on real projects — from focused landing pages to complete online stores.
Writing code is only part of my work. I understand the challenge, plan the structure, design the interface and take the website all the way to launch.
intro.status: Working with projects in Estonia and remotely

format.label: Format
format.description: one point of responsibility for the project

stack.description: I choose tools to fit the challenge, not for fashionable names. For the client, this means a fast website, clear management and room for future growth.

approach.description: No information is lost between a designer and a developer. You communicate directly with the person making decisions and responsible for the result.

clarity.title: Understand the challenge
clarity.description: First I clarify the business goals, audience and primary user action — only then do I propose a solution.

system.title: Create a system
system.description: Structure, visual language and interface work together to make the website consistent and easy to understand.

responsibility.title: Own the result
responsibility.description: I design, develop, test and launch the website myself — without endless handovers between people.

cta.description: Tell me about your project. I will ask a few focused questions and suggest a clear next step.
